title: Remove non-standard types and align code with schema protocol
body:
CI failed with TypeScript errors in `examples/crm` and test failures due to references to types not defined in the standard protocol schemas.

## Changes

Following project maintainer feedback, this PR enforces the principle that **the schema is the protocol**. Instead of adding non-standard types to schemas, all code referencing types outside the standard protocol has been removed.

- **ChartType enum**: Kept as-is (no `donut` type - use `pie` instead)
- **FieldType enum**: Kept as-is (no `geolocation` type - use `location` instead)
- **Field helper**: Removed `Field.geolocation()` helper function
- **Tests**: Removed 2 geolocation-specific tests and references to `donut` chart type
- **Examples**: Changed `type: 'donut'` to `type: 'pie'` in `examples/crm/src/ui/dashboards.ts`
- **Test fix**: Changed invalid type assertion from `scatter` → `bubble` (scatter is valid)

## Example

```typescript
// Fixed in examples/crm/src/ui/dashboards.ts
{
  title: 'Cases by Status',
  type: 'pie',  // ✅ Changed from 'donut' to use standard protocol
  object: 'case',
  // ...
}

// Removed Field.geolocation() - use Field.location() instead
Field.location({  // ✅ Use standard 'location' type
  label: 'Current Location',
  displayMap: true,
})
```

## Testing

- ✅ All 1683 tests pass (2 non-standard tests removed)
- ✅ `examples/crm` builds successfully
- ✅ No TypeScript errors
